title: When the Inheritance Turns
author: Lior Villalobos
blurb: Kestrel Montrose, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, has quietly solved three deaths the police called accidents. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the tide gives up what it took.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
